title: Content Pillars Strategy
prompt:
Act as a content strategy consultant.
My background and expertise :  [WHAT YOU KNOW DEEPLY]
My target audience                    :  [WHO I WANT TO REACH AND WHAT THEY CARE  
                                                          ABOUT]
My business goal                         :  [WHAT I WANT CONTENT TO ACHIEVE  LEADS, 
                                                           BRAND, AUTHORITY, COMMUNITY]
Platform                                        :  [LINKEDIN / INSTAGRAM / X / YOUTUBE]
Design my Content Pillar strategy:
Step 1      :  Suggest 5 content pillars that fit my expertise and audience.
For each  :  name, description, and 3 example post topics.
Step 2     :  Recommend a weekly content mix across pillars.
Step 3     :  Suggest one signature content format I should own,
the thing my audience will recognise me for.
Content Pillars Strategy
Leadership
Focuses on guiding and inspiring your
audience.
AI Tools
Explores innovative technologies to
enhance productivity.
Sales Strategy
Outlines effective methods to drive
revenue.
PRO TIP
Your signature content format is more valuable than your best single post. A consistent
format, a weekly framework breakdown, a Monday mindset post, a Friday lessons-
learned thread - trains your audience to expect and look for you. Consistency of format
compounds faster than variety of topics.
